title: Azure Functions
description: Build serverless, event-driven backends with Azure Functions in C#.
longDescription: Azure Functions lets you run code without managing servers. This module introduces the Functions programming model for .NET, covers HTTP-triggered and timer-triggered functions, and shows how to use dependency injection to keep your function code clean and testable.
whatYouLearn: Understand the Functions hosting models and programming model for .NET
Build HTTP-triggered and timer-triggered functions in C#
Use dependency injection in isolated-process Azure Functions
Handle errors and log from Functions with ILogger
